'''Emerald''' is a [[Minerals|Mineral]]. It can be obtained from [[Mining#Mining Nodes|Emerald Node]]s and [[Mining#Mining Nodes|Gem Node]]s in [[the Mines]], from the green [[Ginger Island#Gem Birds|Gem Bird]] on [[Ginger Island|Ginger Island]] during [[Weather#Weather Types|rainy days]], from [[Pans|panning]], or in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]]. It has a 10% chance to be dropped by a slain [[Dwarvish Sentry]] in the [[Volcano Dungeon]]. It may occasionally be found in a [[Garbage Can]] after the player has reached the bottom of the mines.  It can also be received as a gift at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces an Emerald on the birthdays of [[Clint]], [[Emily]], and [[Penny]]. 

[[Cheese]] may be purchased at the [[Desert Trader]] on [[Days of the Week#Friday|Fridays]] in exchange for 1 Emerald.

==Bundles==
Emerald is one of the options for the {{bundle|treasure hunter||y}}.

==Forging==
Emerald can be used at the [[Forge]] to increase the speed of a melee weapon.

==Recipes==
Emerald is not used in any [[Cooking|recipes]].

==Tailoring==
Emerald is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt144.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
*Emerald may be randomly requested during any season at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|750}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.  Emerald will never be requested until you have reached floors 80+ of [[The Mines]].
*Two Emeralds may be requested by [[Octopus]], [[Rainbow Trout]], [[Spook Fish]], or [[Super Cucumber]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.
*Emerald will be requested by [[Emily]] as part of the "Rock Rejuvenation" quest at the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders]] board outside Mayor [[Lewis]]' house.
*May be used in the [[Ginger Island#Gem Birds|Gem Birds]] puzzle on Ginger Island.
